original.statement: Loki's log results cache now composes the empty response from the request being served, so it no longer returns an incorrect limit or direction.

decision.reason: [ev-180d9754a48a] says the Loki log results cache now builds its empty response from the request being served, so it no longer returns an incorrect limit or direction. That is a runtime change in how responses behave, with the same configuration, so behavior-changed fits. The name log-results-cache-empty-response is short kebab-case taken from the evidence's own words. The changelog doesn't treat any separate component as owning this subject, so leaving component out is correct.
